chunks.title: Overview
chunks.text: I'd like to show you this cool machine I have. In fact, it's one of my most prized possessions that my great uncle gave to me before he passed away. Let's pretend that this machine represents a company and that I'm the CEO of that company.

chunks.title: Overview
chunks.text: This company can take raw materials like this paper and process them and turn them into dollars. Here's how it works. So each year this company can output a dollar bill reliably. What is this company worth?
